verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

Approved. The change preserves the fail-closed decision while separating a missing YAML parser from a measured workflow-wiring failure. The new sentinel remains falsy at all interlock consumers, mixed unmeasurable/unwired states retain both diagnostics, and workflow parse/anchor/job failures still follow the ordinary seam-finding path. The policy-resolve mutation fixtures now use a literal all-ready baseline, removing their dependency on live environment results. The added tests exercise both affected review-fix probes, verify restoration of the real YAML module, and pin the exception split without weakening trust checks or workflow security controls.
